new_entries.title: Two-cell period-4 absorption for the word 0001
new_entries.abstract: Let $w=0001$, and let the right half of rule 30 be driven by $w^\infty$. The ether-and-wall absorption conjecture says every finitely supported right half eventually enters a fixed ether-aligned family ending in a 13-cell wall; for $w=0001$ it would exclude the centre tail $0001^\infty$ and least period 4. We prove the two-cell case in Lean: for every pair of positions $p<q$ and every phase $\varphi$, the right half with black cells at $p$ and $q$ only enters the ether-and-wall family for alignment $(5,0)$ or $(6,0)$. The proof splits at $p$: for $p\ge31$ both cells lie outside the backward light cone of the wall window at the all-white entry time; for $p=0$ the orbit reduces to the single-cell case; for $1\le p\le30$, second cells beyond the single-cell witness's light cone transfer from the reference orbit, and the remaining finitely many pairs are checked by a bit-packed kernel computation whose soundness against `drv` is proved. The source is kernel-checked with only `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`, and contains no `sorry`, `native_decide` or `bv_decide`. This is a partial result for Problem 1: the two-cell restriction of the open period-4 absorption conjecture, not full absorption and not a period-4 exclusion.
